Create an ORIGINAL game vehicle sprite for the Thane T60 farm tractor: a small, older-style utility tractor that pulls light ploughs, cultivators and seed drills on a hard-scrabble frontier farm. No implement, no plough, no trailer, no crop, no people, no animals, no dust, mud or damage, no text, letters, numbers, logos, dials or screens. No floor, ground, field, road, shadow outside the tractor, perspective, tilt or visible side faces. Top surfaces only.
